item.title: Uppal flyover works to finish by March, GHMC tells residents
item.description: Commuters on the Warangal highway have faced delays for two years; the corporation says the remaining spans will be completed by March.

item.title: Heavy rain: control room opened as Gachibowli and Madhapur report waterlogging
item.description: The disaster response teams were deployed at vulnerable points in the IT corridor, officials said.
